title: Golden retrieval query
description: What: one labelled query for Gate 1 (doc 07 s4.1). Use when: the golden runner prints Gate 1 confusion counts and recall@k, and when calibration replaces the provisional thresholds. Role: the dataset contract; tests/test_golden_set.py validates every query.

tier.description: as in SearchRequest: public when unverified

gold_chunk_ids.description: any one in the fused top k counts as a hit; empty unless answerable

forbidden_chunk_ids.description: chunks that must not be returned for this tier

near_miss.description: shares vocabulary or topic with the docs (D-052: such queries can score near tau_high and so test the threshold; unmeasured)

absent_terms.description: words that prove the label: none may appear in data/articles
